changelog: Plex-inspired library layout for Jellyfin 12.1: desktop sidebar using existing profile-visible navigation, active library heading, a search pill, smaller spaced posters, left-aligned transparent captions, and quieter toolbar and count badges. Smaller screens retain native navigation. Filter, sort, grid/list view, details, and playback remain Jellyfin controls. Adds an appearance opt-out while preserving existing settings and the catalog update pipeline.
description: A unified cinematic Jellyfin Web customization with a profile-forward login screen, Plex-inspired theme, and rotating library-driven home hero.
name: Cinematic UI
overview: Cinematic login and home experience for Jellyfin Web
